purpose: Source videos used by the Comfy/LTX sprite post-processing pipeline.

idle.notes: Stable fighting-stance frames used as the first proper idle loop. Current selection uses a wider subtle stance arc from the cleaned LTX frame rip.

walk.notes: Cleanest available side-view green-screen walk cycle. Current selection samples the full stored walk video and is promoted through chroma-cleaned frames.

dash.notes: Six-second dash source from the earlier A.Ben LTX revision set. Useful as a motion candidate; still needs later hand cleanup for final production quality.

jump.notes: First functioning jump candidate. Motion is usable for runtime verification but still marked for later art cleanup.

punch.notes: Current strongest attack source; used for light punch and related punch actions.

kick.notes: First kick candidate; extended frames still show LTX color drift.
